products.label: PDS Rings Node Uranus ring table
products.process: Choose a ring in proportion to its opacity, 1 - exp(-tau), times its published width times its radius; place a dot in Uranus's ring plane within that width; repeat 600 times. The dot's longitude and its place across the width come from a seeded generator.
limitations: No ring particle has a measured position. Only each ring's share of the dots is measured; each dot's longitude is drawn from a seeded generator.
The 600 dots and their size are display choices. At the density of Saturn's dots Uranus would have about 5. The dots are the neutral gray of the ring lines.
